value_or_null.description: One RPMI8226 line, source also typoRPMI8225/RPMIN8226 retained as source wording not separate models. No patient/donor/animal treatment experiment,normal-cell selectivity or established resistant-cell model.

Metformin1.25-40mM48h screen,melphalan.08-250uM24h,combinationMet10mM plusMel2-250uM. Principal apoptosis/comet24hMet10mM/Mel10uM and rotenone1mM. Concomitant CCK8 schedule not fully reconciled to unequal single-agent durations; not clinical doses.

Figure1C melphalan axis labelsmm whereas methods/captionuM; retain mismatch. Figure4 axesLN(c),captionLg/base10,body ATPfitXnatural log; exact concentration/log-unit mapping unresolved. No silent unit conversion or dose-dependent quantitative repair.

CCK8metabolic readout/pair-vsMel differences not independent direct counts. Authors report CompusynCI<1, a formal model-based synergy claim, but no exactCI/Fa/grid/rawdata/reproducible interaction estimate. Not independently verified clinical synergy; sourceCI=1 increased-effect wording not adopted as validated definition.

Abstract apoptosis12.7+/-2.8% to18.8+/-1.5% P<.05 differs from Figure2 aggregate bars substantially higher and representative early-plus-late quadrant sums25.7%Mel/46.1%pair. Different gate/summary basis not explained, unresolved; no inferred cause or forced replacement.

Figure2 representative MelD2=11.5/D4=14.2 and pair15.5/30.6 are individual plotted quadrant percentages, not independent aggregate biological means. Figure2B bars/SD and significance brackets P<.01 differ from abstractP<.05; do not substitute sums for reported means, digitize bars or assert exact gate definition resolved.

Rotenone1mM alone has marked apoptosis and pairing withMel increases effects/lowers ATP. Pharmacologic phenocopy supports energy-related rationale but is not a specific rescue/necessity test or proof normal-cell safety. No rotenone clinical regimen implied.

24h alkaline comet shows larger tail/comet length and tail/Olive moments withpair versusMel. Source alternatesDNA-base/double-strand language, assay not direct repair-rate/pathway-specific readout. No ATP restoration/genetic rescue or orthogonal repair kinetics establishes impaired repair rather than increased damage/other effects.

Abstract ATP.42+/-.01 to.08+/-.02uM P<.05 retained as source-reported contrast; Figure4C/D and brokenDaxis distinguish drug conditions, captionP<.01. No exact fullATP dose means/CI digitized or per-cell/protein normalization independently established.

Lower ATP can accompany fewer viable cells. Discussion claims an equal-apoptosis Mel-only comparator gives different ATP, but exact matched Mel dose/N/results are not supplied separately. This sensitivity rationale is narrative only, not an independently verified exclusion of cell-loss confounding or necessary ATP-mediated repair mechanism.

ComplexI/ATP/repair explanation largely from ATP/comet/rotenone association and background references; no own measured complexI respiration/AMPK/AKT/mTOR/GRP78 perturbation or ATP rescue. Do not import these cited mechanisms as actual assays of this report.

Triplicates/meanSD/t-tests given, no biological-versus-technical hierarchy,flowevent/gating counts,comet nucleiN,power/blinding/randomization or global multiplicity. Seeded500k/well and1million/well are cell counts,not biological replicates/patients; no invented complete means/CI.

Few-side-effects and potential clinical treatment claims are author extrapolations. No parallel healthy cells,clinicalPK/BBB/renal or adverse-event evaluation,animal survival or patient benefit/dosing established by10mM culture/1mMrotenone.

CAL19 reference28 citation-only not prior fresh acceptance. Reference13MalekGRP782015 is futureCAL24 original, no data transfer now. ATP assay reference21 concerns microbiological water quality,not direct independent validation of this cell-normalized ATP assay; no external repair or primary PASS from references.
